title: Fresh Herbs of Fabius
about: Up in the hills of southeastern Onondaga County, Fresh Herbs of Fabius has grown gourmet vegetables, edible flowers and microgreens since 2000. It is a small operation on Ridge Road that grows without chemicals and has built its business around chefs.

Microgreens and flowers come out of the greenhouse all year, so even in the middle of a Central New York winter the farm can supply the tender shoots, petals and blossoms that finish a plate. Other kitchens in the region also buy its chamomile and specialty herbs.
The farm delivers its harvest itself to restaurants between Utica and Auburn, which means the greens on your plate were usually cut only a day or so before.
